note: HOW A DEVICE'S EXPORT IS READ. Every biometric device in this market exports a delimited log file, and every vendor orders the columns differently — so the layout is DATA here, not a `case 'zkteco'` in PHP. A new device model is an edit to this file, which is what SmartPRS 2 needs a release for. Reading a ZKTeco file with an eSSL layout produces rows that parse cleanly and mean something else, so the layout is named on every import and never guessed. `identifies` says which employee column the device's own id maps to: `device_user_id` for an enrolment number, `emp_code` for exports that already carry the employee code. Every field below is required — a punch with no declared direction would have to be given one, and a payable day computed from an invented direction is one nobody can audit.
